hypothesis: Catalogue pixels that are hardest to see (weak 1 m-LiDAR step, deep basement, gentle detrended slope) are the catalogue subpopulation most similar to expert-added hidden faults; up-weighting them in a physical-feature ranker shifts dotted emission toward covered piedmont faults instead of easy bedrock/range-front traces.
mechanism: Fold-fair HistGradientBoosting PU ranker (300 iters, lr 0.06, 63 leaves) on 41 physical channels (19 official GeoDAWN/topo bands, 10 LiDAR scarp bands, 8 radiometric/extension bands, 4 unsupervised H73-1 components); positives = visible catalogue (48,340 px) weighted 1+2h; negatives = 250,000 footprint px >5 px from VISIBLE faults only; no distance-to-catalogue feature, no scored-raster input. Frozen dotted emission: 37,654 dots, 2.5 px spacing, >2.0 px from visible (production: full) catalogue. Production surface retrained on the full 60,988-px catalogue with the identical recipe.
named_non_fault_mimic: Lithologic contacts and alluvial-fan surfaces (magnetic/gravity/radiometric signature of covered faults without faulting), plus catalogue mapping bias itself - where mappers looked is not where hidden faults are.

holdout.control_reproduction: Control rebuilt identically to the merged H73-1 lane reproduced its published 0.093861 exactly (random 0.0484 and static-champion 0.0037 also exact): the comparison is on one unchanged instrument.
holdout.mechanism_reading: E1 (hard-weighted) 0.1369 vs E2 (unweighted) 0.1364: the hard-weighting is nearly inert on this instrument (+0.0005); the measured gain comes from the supervised physical stack itself. E3 without any scarp-family feature still scores 0.1211 > control 0.0939, so geophysics/radiometrics carry independent catalogue-holdout signal. The hypothesis' weighting mechanism is NOT confirmed by this run.
holdout.transfer_caveat: HOLDOUT-DTI truth is withheld CATALOGUE segments, so this instrument structurally favours catalogue-supervised fields; the hidden expert set was selected for catalogue ABSENCE. Sibling supervised lanes live-scored 0.0286-0.2478 (OWNER-REPORT) despite strong catalogue fit. This card claims a holdout result, never a live score; whether the +0.043 transfers is exactly what one selector-approved slot would test.
holdout.production_caveat: HOLDOUT-DTI describes the fold-fair twin (trained on the 48,340 visible px). The shipped bytes come from the same recipe retrained on all 60,988 catalogue px.
